title: L111 — THE VOLUME THAT ARRIVED EARLY
_cellule: SETD (Sniper) · Curiosité · Risk · regard=autres traders · futur · −−
voice: You watched the candle close green and felt safe, but the volume bar underneath was three times the average and nobody was talking about it.
When volume spikes without a move, the orders are being absorbed, and the market is loading pressure that the candle does not show yet.
A large buyer at a resistance does not push the price up, because the seller absorbs every contract without retreating.
The candle stays flat while the volume screams, and the next candle resolves the pressure in one direction.
Read the volume before you trust the candle. Follow KONGRAVE — the mechanics nobody explains.
